name: Toudou Takeshi
source:
The protagonist of this work. A very ordinary young man, he is a virgin and his tone is very blunt, but his character is rather straightforward. He is grateful to his mother for raising him on her own but has secretly always been obsessed with her breasts ever since he was a child.
